answer.summary: A compact, sparse monastery stepped down a cliff in terraces near the founding stone. It has a cliff chapel at its heart, five monks' cells, a refectory, a scriptorium, a bell tower on high ground and a sea landing. The land isn't surveyed, so I haven't named any sea or cliff. The landing and cliff setting need water and a slope nearby.
